history.name: WyattBlue/auto-editor
history.summary: Adds subtitle burn-in and text generators, scale and rotation actions, audio convolution, polygon masks and timed keyframes; imports FCP7 dissolves and warns about export limitations.
changes: Adds subtitle burn-in and text generators, scale and rotation actions, audio convolution, polygon masks and timed keyframes; imports FCP7 dissolves and warns about export limitations.

history.name: WyattBlue/auto-editor
history.summary: Skips damaged packets without aborting analysis, drains decoders and avoids caching incomplete analysis; progress output moves to stderr.
changes: Skips damaged packets without aborting analysis, drains decoders and avoids caching incomplete analysis; progress output moves to stderr.

history.name: auto-editor
history.summary: Audio tone and overlay generators; source-stream handling and decoder fixes.
changes: Adds MIDI-pitched tone generation with sine, saw, square and triangle waves.
Imports all source streams through add, including audio-only sources.
Supports drawbox as a separate overlay generator.
Skips undecodable audio streams and identifies missing codecs in errors.
Updates bundled x265 to 4.3 and libvpx to 1.17.0.
